basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support III (Pulmonary Medicine) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support-III post at All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Jodhpur will be held on 3 November 2026. Reporting starts at 09:00 AM and closes at 10:00 AM at Room No. 031, Ground Floor, B Block, OPD, Department of Pulmonary Medicine, AIIMS, Jodhpur. There is 1 post, on a purely temporary basis in the ICMR-funded RUNNER trial project, with a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000 + 20% HRA.

age_limit.details: The age limit for Project Technical Support-III is 35 Year, as printed in the notice. An age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis. The notice says this concession applies only to an ICMR project, and this project is funded by ICMR.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 1 post of Project Technical Support-III. Applicants must meet the essential qualification, experience and age limit below. The age limit for Project Technical Support-III is 35 Year, as printed in the notice. An age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis. The notice says this concession applies only to an ICMR project, and this project is funded by ICMR. The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits. It is based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skill set and so on. The initial contract is for one year from the date of appointment. It may be extended for another year based on the performance evaluation report (extended as per norms) and the project's needs. The position can be terminated at any point in time. The post is purely temporary/contractual for the specified period, based on the project, and co-terminus with the project. The candidate will have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur, or continuation of service in any other project. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application form, filled in the prescribed format (given in the notice), with a passport size photo Bio-data All relevant original documents One set of self-attested photocopies of documents for age, educational qualifications and relevant work experience All essential qualification and experience certificates, enclosed with the application form. Without them the application will be considered incomplete. A "No Objection Certificate", only for persons working in Govt. or a Public Sector undertaking The "Format of Application" printed at the end of the notice asks for:

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the venue between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM on 3 November 2026. No additional candidates will be entertained for the interview after 10:00 AM. Submit the filled application form with your bio-data. You must appear in person. Depending on the number of applicants, the Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Security Test. Attend the walk-in interview for the post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The number of posts may increase or decrease as required, at the sole discretion of the Research Section, AIIMS, Jodhpur. No enquiries will be entertained after the due date.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 November 2026 at Room No. 031, Ground Floor, B Block, OPD, Department of Pulmonary Medicine, AIIMS, Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Reporting starts at 09:00 AM and closes at 10:00 AM on 3 November 2026. No additional candidates will be entertained for the interview after 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Project Technical Support-III in the RUNNER trial project of the Department of Pulmonary Medicine. The number of posts may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Research Section, AIIMS, Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The notice prints: "Three years of graduation (Science/Psychology/Public Health + three years' experience in a relevant subject/ field." Qualifications must be full-time and from a recognized Board/University, and the experience must have been gained after the minimum qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Year. An age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis, and only for an ICMR project.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs. 28,000 + 20% HRA. The notice calls the salary a consolidated sum without any other benefits, based on experience, qualifications and skill set.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice's post table gives the monthly salary as Rs. 28,000 + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form in the prescribed format with your bio-data, all relevant original documents, and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents for age, qualifications and work experience. The essential qualification and experience certificates must be enclosed with the form.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through a walk-in interview. Depending on the number of applicants, the Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Security Test.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and for how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial contract is for one year, may be extended for another year based on performance and the project's needs, and can be terminated at any time.
